title: Review: spec 0003 implementation
description: Review all changes from spec 0003 for correctness, spec compliance, UI guidelines adherence, security-scoped resource handling hygiene, test coverage, and absence of out-of-scope features. Verify xcodebuild test passes. Flag visual-only items (thumbnail loading, section animation, search-clear behaviour) as requiring manual visual review by the user.
acceptance_criteria: All spec 0003 acceptance criteria are addressed in the implementation.
Security-scoped bookmark access is always bracketed by start/stopAccessingSecurityScopedResource.
Stale bookmark handling clears UserDefaults and shows FolderSetupView.
No out-of-scope features introduced (persistent cache, multi-select, recursive scan, etc.).
All tests pass using Swift Testing.
Visual-only items are explicitly flagged for manual user review.
UI guidelines (stock SwiftUI, SF Symbols, semantic colours, accessibility labels) are followed.
